fusions.name: Unpicked Thread
fusions.desc: Unpicks the target for 15 damage, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Quick Fingers
fusions.desc: Flicks a spool that deals 4 damage. It has a 30% chance to tangle the target's hands, leaving it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Deft Retie
fusions.desc: Unties 2 conditions from you. Your movement speed rises by 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Loose Ends
fusions.desc: When a condition on you ends, you regain 6 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
